name: Ecwid
one_liner: Ecommerce platform (Lightspeed) adding stores to any site, with REST API, OAuth apps and webhooks.
auth_notes: Public apps use OAuth 2.0; a store's custom app provides a secret token used as Bearer token plus store ID in the path. Custom apps have limited default permissions (no webhooks until app configuration updated).
access_notes: Only stores on paid plans can access the API; free upgrade for test stores on request to API support. Public App Market apps go through validation.
sandbox_or_test_env: No test mode in the API; docs recommend a separate test store (free paid-plan upgrade on request).

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API with Bearer tokens and OAuth, but the store needs a paid plan and public apps need validation; no sandbox mode.
